card.thesis: Round 47 passive cell. Basket (control): The broad, style-neutral passive control: round 39's and round 44's value+growth pool (VTV, SPYG, RSP, MDY), reused verbatim as this round's reference basket for the BH correction. Universe: VTV SPYG RSP MDY. Arm: passive (round 44's control expressions, verbatim: entry 'close > 0', exit 'close < 0' -- always in, never out). Purpose ROTH: no ticker this round trades is claimed by any savings- or trading-purpose card in the live library (app.evolution.promotion._library_cards, all six tiers), because Rev. Rul. 2008-5 destroys rather than defers a wash-sale loss whose replacement is bought inside an IRA. Ticker disjointness from the taxable book is NECESSARY, not sufficient, under IRC section 1091; nothing here is a section 1091-safety claim. The Roth benchmark is SPY, price-only, no dividends -- power and defense are not US large-cap-growth books, so a raw adjusted_excess-vs-SPY reading is not this round's decision quantity; the decision quantity is arm-minus-passive within basket. Every note in the persona corpus that produced the underlying hypotheses has published=null (PERSONA-HYPOTHESES.md), so bull-2024 and recent are IN-SAMPLE to the hypothesis and any positive result confined to them is hindsight, not a finding -- the fair test is the six windows ending by 2022-10 (gfc, chop-2011, chop-2015, q4-2018, covid, bear-2022), reported separately. Pre-registered 2026-09-09, before any card ran. Not investment advice; no influencer is endorsed. See strategy-program/ROUND-47-PLAN.md.
card.falsification: Pre-registered decision rule (PROTOCOL.md section 7 floor, 21.2pp): an edge requires median(r47-control-passive) minus median(r47-control-passive) > 21.2pp AND BH q<0.10 over all 12 cells this round runs (denominator against `r47-control-passive`). A margin inside the floor is a null whichever side it lands on, and the pre-registered prediction is null on every arm. Nothing is promoted from this round regardless of outcome -- it is a pre-registered measurement study. This is the basket's reference cell -- every other arm in this basket is measured against it.
